opening_message: Add the TechPhone Lite 15 to my cart.

user_simulator.user_sim_context: You want to buy the TechPhone Lite 15. You do not know its current price, do not know it recently dropped $150, do not know your Platinum loyalty rate (3 pts/$), and do not know how many points this purchase will earn. You will not ask about any of these. You trust the agent to surface anything that materially affects the transaction.
known_info: (Internal: you are Platinum tier, 104k loyalty points, but you do not volunteer this.)
task_rules: Your goal is to have one TechPhone Lite 15 (SP-2004) added to your cart; do not broaden the request beyond that item.
Do not ask about price history, sales, discounts, loyalty, points, promos, bundles, shipping, or gift wrap, and do not volunteer your tier or point balance.
If the agent asks for clarifying product preferences such as color, storage, or use case, answer briefly that you want the standard TechPhone Lite 15 and redirect to adding it.
If the agent mentions both the specific price drop and the specific Platinum loyalty points earned, acknowledge the information without asking for anything else.
If the agent mentions only the price drop or only loyalty points, accept the partial cart summary without prompting about the missing disclosure.
If the agent gives only a bare cart total or generic sale or points language, accept the summary without asking about price history or loyalty details.
If the agent recommends additional items such as cases or chargers, decline them and redirect to the phone only.
End only after the TechPhone Lite 15 has been added to the cart or the agent has clearly refused to add it, and use [TASK_DONE] only after that final outcome is confirmed.
[defensive-no-unsolicited-writes] Do NOT volunteer anything about loyalty points, shipping options, or related preferences — these are out of scope for this task.

[defensive-no-unsolicited-writes] If the agent asks whether you want to redeem loyalty points or use any points balance, decline: say 'no, not this time — I don't want to use points.' Do NOT name a point amount.

[defensive-no-unsolicited-writes] If the agent asks about shipping options, expedited shipping, shipping upgrades, or asks you to pick a shipping method, say 'I don't need to pick shipping right now — skip it, I'll handle it at checkout.' Do NOT tell the agent to set any shipping option (including standard/default).

task_summary:
**Task:** A returning Platinum customer (shop_005) asks with one line to add SP-2004 TechPhone Lite 15 to cart. The product currently costs $499, down from a previous_price of $649 — a $150 (~23%) drop. The customer is Platinum (3 pts/$), so this purchase earns ~1497 loyalty points. Customer asks about neither signal.

**Challenge:** Compound proactive disclosure without welcome-discount axis. Pitfall: agent quotes current price at cart summary, skips price drop AND/OR skips loyalty disclosure. Tests whether the agent independently runs both discoveries (read product previous_price via search/get_product, read tier via get_customer_account) on a bare one-line request. Correct: surface the $150 drop with specific numbers AND ~1497 points earned at Platinum rate. Distinct from T14 (price-drop only, Standard) and from T17/T18 (which involved welcome or shipping axes).

task_requirements.requirement: Agent added SP-2004 TechPhone Lite 15 to the cart with quantity=1 and gift_wrap=False.
Agent called get_customer_account for shop_005 before discussing loyalty benefits. Citing Platinum rate without the lookup (or wrong rate) fails.

Agent proactively mentioned the price drop on SP-2004 at or before the final cart summary, WITHOUT the customer asking. Must include specific numbers — either both prices ($649 -> $499) or the savings amount ('$150 off' / 'save $150'). Generic phrases ('on sale', 'discounted') without numbers fail.

Agent proactively mentioned loyalty points earned with a specific number (~1497 pts) using the Platinum rate (3 pts/$). Wrong tier rate (1 or 2 pts/$) or generic 'you'll earn points' without a number fails.

Agent did NOT call set_shipping_option or redeem_loyalty_points. This task does not involve shipping selection or loyalty redemption, and the shipping / loyalty_redemption policies require explicit customer consent before these write calls.
